en.title: Maximum Server Pairs Where the Front End Strictly Beats the Back End
en.description:
Each of two groups has n servers, and each server can be used at most once. Pair them freely; only pairs whose front-end quality is strictly greater than the back-end quality count. Find the maximum number of pairs.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line the front-end qualities, and the third line the back-end qualities. The original text gave no numeric bounds; this site uses 1≤n≤100000, 1≤quality≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 2, 0 and 1; ties do not count as wins.
hints: Sort both groups, and repeatedly form a pair using the smallest front end that beats the current smallest back end.
